summary: D1-PR-002 is resolved, but the Proposal still omits the mandatory Archive task-completion gate and lets delivery-finalize accept Full Test not-applicable even though that is not a FullTestStatus. Both defects make Policy authorize progress without representable required facts.

blockingFindings.title: Archive gate omits mandatory task completion and has no fact-availability behavior
blockingFindings.evidence: docs/delivery-lifecycle.md requires Tasks completed before Archive. The Proposal's archive precondition includes approved review, blocking findings, Verification, and owner authorization, but not task completion. FormalFactSnapshot exposes change-tasks existence only; it exposes no task-completion status. The Proposal therefore has neither the required gate nor a fail-closed outcome when the required fact is unavailable.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add task completion as an Archive prerequisite. Because the current snapshot cannot represent completion, specify and test a distinct fail-closed tasks-facts-unavailable diagnosis until an upstream snapshot extension exists; do not infer completion from artifact existence, Run history, or chat. Update Design, Spec, Tasks, and the Archive decision path consistently.

blockingFindings.title: delivery-finalize permits an unrepresentable Full Test not-applicable state
blockingFindings.evidence: The Proposal requires Full Test passed or not-applicable for delivery-finalize. `not-applicable` belongs to Change VerificationStatus, not Delivery FullTestStatus. B1 FullTestStatus is not-ready | awaiting-user-decision | authorized | passed | failed, and the Delivery lifecycle owner-decision for finalize is conditioned on Full Test passed.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Require snapshot.deliveryFullTestStatus = passed for delivery-finalize and add negative table-driven coverage for every non-passed FullTestStatus. Remove Full Test not-applicable from Design, Spec, Tasks, and any related decision rules; it must not be conflated with Change Verification not-applicable.
